regions.name: Philadelphia
regions.model_scope: Philadelphia independent 2024–25 grade-school district models use exact NCES LEA 4218990 / PA-126515001 / native AUN 126515001 identities. All 162 audited pure lower profiles with positive October grades 3–8 and explicit-zero grades 9–12 remain searchable and enter separate fixed Math, ELA and independently fitted Combined models. Original regular PSSA All Students / Total published proficiency and Number Scored are matched to each school’s own October individual PIMS low-income ratio. Conditional sampling intervals propagate every model member’s scored-count variance while holding deleted regression scale fixed. Combined uses the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance bound and displays the smaller subject count; this display is not a paired or deduplicated denominator. High, mixed, primary, inactive and unmatched records remain outside the release; Keystone and PASA remain separate.
regions.map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Philadelphia source release.
